relevance_note: Narrative review of genetic predisposition to Behcet's disease ("In this review, we summarize genetic predisposition to BD."); its TNFAIP3/HA20 section describes the disease only in general terms ("Patients carrying HA20 present with periodic fevers, recurrent aphthous stomatitis, genital ulceration") and describes no individual patient or TNFAIP3 variant.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; no script transcription. The only person-level case descriptions concern other genes (TNFRSF1A, LIG4, WDR1, STAT1, ADA2, AP1S3, LYN, NEMO, RELA, NFKB1), none with a TNFAIP3 variant, so individuals, variants, phenotypic_features and phenotype_checklist are left empty. Table 1's TNFAIP3 row lists disease-level common features with references [12,13,26,27,28], not individual patients. n_patients_reported is null because the authors state no count of TNFAIP3 patients; cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is null because the review has no patients of its own and makes no such statement. Minor internal inconsistency (not patient-level): the abstract says the TNFAIP3 mutation causing HA20 'was found ... in 2016', while the introduction says it 'was identified at the end of 2015'.
